sample_construction: Verified historical intersection of 5 underlyings with funding settlements + 1h price history on 2 venues; no market-cap rank; shorter history vs the >=3-year confirmatory requirement; contract identity by underlying symbol only.
uncertainty: Not estimable: signal episodes overlap within a 24-hour holding window and are not independent; the sample window is ~97 days vs the >=3-year confirmatory requirement. No block-bootstrap confidence interval is reported.
